scope: CPU-only full scheduler maintenance with profiling enabled, real causal graphs and a 1ms logical cycle. The baseline retains its timing decorator. Observation sinks and idle semantic workers are stubs; no native socket, allocator, decode, DMA or GPU throughput is measured. Only sample_wall_ms and shared_path_timing are excluded from policy-row equality.
phase_partition_semantics: CPU fixture dispatch boundary only; no GPU is launched. The optimized observation call runs after that boundary using the same logical time and queue. Total cost and observation records are retained. This does not measure actual GPU overlap, hidden CPU time or throughput.
